What if consciousness isn’t created by the brain, but is a fundamental property of the universe itself?

Computer chip inventor and physicist Federico Faggin, together with Professor Giacomo Mauro D’Ariano, has proposed a theory known as Quantum Information Panpsychism (QIP), suggesting that consciousness exists at the quantum level of reality and may be woven into the fabric of the cosmos.

According to this model:

✨ Consciousness is fundamental, not a byproduct of matter.

✨ The brain may function more like an interface than the source of awareness.

✨ Free will could emerge from deeper quantum processes rather than purely biological mechanisms.

✨ Reality may be far more interconnected than we currently understand.

If consciousness is fundamental to the universe, then perhaps we are not separate beings trying to connect to something greater.

Perhaps we are expressions of a greater consciousness remembering who we truly are.

This possibility changes everything about how we view healing, manifestation, intuition, and our role in creating reality.

What do you think?

Does free will come from the brain, or could it emerge from the quantum field itself?
